name: Don Mega 1g Pre-Roll
description: Lineage: GMO x Black Banana Type: Hybrid Terpenes: D-Limonene, Caryophyllene, ß-Myrcene Effects: Relaxed, Sleepy, Calming Aroma: Skunk, Chem, Garlic Step into the bold realm of Don Mega, a strain that commands attention and respect. With buds that glisten like the city lights in the night, this powerhouse hybrid is a fusion of potency and elegance. The aroma dances between earthy and citrus notes, a scent that mirrors the dynamic cityscape it represents. Don Mega's effects are a symphony of relaxation and euphoria, providing a luxurious escape from the everyday hustle. This strain is like the quintessential top hat and cane of the cannabis realm, beckoning you to indulge in a high that befits royalty.
